title: Physical properties and gas kinematics of massive star forming region G328.24−0.55
question: Pin down the physical and kinematic properties (cores, masses, excitation temperatures, rotation, outflow) of the young stellar objects in the massive star forming region G328.24-0.55

recipe.goal: calibrate and image continuum and line cubes
recipe.method: Standard CASA calibration; uvcontsub to split line-free continuum and line-only data; tclean with CLEAN, Briggs robust 0.5, primary-beam correction
2D Gaussian fit in the image plane with CASA gaussfit to get position, peak intensity, integrated flux and size of each core

recipe.goal: identify molecular lines and measure line properties
recipe.method: Spectra extracted within a 0.5 arcsec diameter around each continuum peak; lines identified with MADCUBA SLIM autofit using CDMS/JPL; 2D Gaussian profile fits of lines give intensity and linewidth
key_parameters: Detection threshold >=3 sigma with rms 4 mJy/beam
Spectral extraction diameter 0.5 arcsec (0.7 arcsec for CO in MM1a)
assumptions: Sources are isolated within the extraction diameter, comparable to the synthesized beam

recipe.method: Rotational diagram of CH3OH lines (v_t = 0-2) assuming LTE for MM1a, MM1b, MM1c
key_parameters: E_up range 46-508 K (MM1a, MM1b) and 46-190 K (MM1c)

recipe.method: Near kinematic distance from V_LSR of the unblended CH3OH 10_{2,8}-9_{3,7} line, using the revised kinematic distance estimation

recipe.goal: derive core masses and beam-averaged H2 column densities
recipe.method: Optically thin dust mass M_d = S_nu D^2 / (kappa_nu B_nu(T_d)) at ~230 GHz; column density from beam-averaged flux with gas-to-dust 100; T_d = CH3OH T_ex for MM1a-c and 20 K for MM2, MM3
assumptions: T_d for MM2 and MM3 = 20 K; T_ex used as T_d for MM1a-c

recipe.goal: derive ionizing photon rate from MeerKAT free-free flux
recipe.method: 2D Gaussian fit of the MeerKAT continuum (CASA gaussfit) for flux; ionizing photon rate formula with T_e = 6343 K; spectral type inferred
key_parameters: T_e = 6343 K; D = 2.8 kpc; S_nu = 8.61 mJy
assumptions: Free-free emission from an HII region ionized by a single star

recipe.goal: test for a rotating structure with CH3OH moment maps
recipe.method: Moment 0, 1 and 2 maps of CH3OH 10_{2,8}-9_{3,7}; 2D Gaussian size of the moment-0 emission; spectrum within 0.52 arcsec diameter
key_parameters: Spectrum extracted within a 0.52 arcsec diameter

recipe.goal: characterize CO outflow and its dynamical timescale
recipe.method: CO 2-1 emission integrated over blue- and red-shifted velocity ranges and overlaid on the continuum; t_d = R_max / Delta v_max, averaged over lobes
key_parameters: Blue lobe -51.8 to -46.4 km/s; red lobe -36.2 to -27.3 km/s
Outflow inclination ~46 deg to the plane of the sky
assumptions: MM1a is the driving source of the outflow
